logger.doc:name: Start Snapshot Processing
logger.message: #['[Correlation ID: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ '] Processing warehouse snapshot: ' ++ vars.sourceFileName]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var timestampText = ((vars.sourceFileName splitBy "_")[2]) replace ".csv" with "" --- timestampText as LocalDateTime {format: "yyyyMMddHHmm"}

db:select.doc:name: Check Duplicate Snapshot
db:select.db:sql: SELECT snapshot_id, file_name, status FROM snapshot_log WHERE file_name = :fileName LIMIT 1

db:select.doc:name: Check Latest Warehouse Snapshot
db:select.db:sql: SELECT snapshot_ts FROM snapshot_log WHERE warehouse_code = :warehouseCode AND status = 'PROCESSED' ORDER BY snapshot_ts DESC LIMIT 1

db:insert.doc:name: Record Stale Snapshot Log
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO snapshot_log (file_name, file_checksum, warehouse_code, snapshot_ts, status, total_rows, accepted_rows, rejected_rows, correlation_id, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (:fileName, :fileChecksum, :warehouseCode, :snapshotTs, 'SKIPPED_STALE', 0, 0, 0, :correlationId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ fileName: vars.sourceFileName, fileChecksum: vars.fileChecksum default 'STALE_CHK', warehouseCode: vars.warehouseCode, snapshotTs: vars.snapshotTimestamp, correlationId: vars.correlationId }]

logger.doc:name: Log Stale Skipped
logger.message: #['Stale snapshot skipped: ' ++ vars.sourceFileName ++ '. Older than latest processed high-water mark.']

db:insert.doc:name: Create IN_PROGRESS Snapshot Log
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO snapshot_log (file_name, file_checksum, warehouse_code, snapshot_ts, status, total_rows, accepted_rows, rejected_rows, correlation_id, started_at) VALUES (:fileName, :fileChecksum, :warehouseCode, :snapshotTs, 'IN_PROGRESS', :totalRows, 0, 0, :correlationId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ fileName: vars.sourceFileName, fileChecksum: vars.fileChecksum default 'ACTIVE_CHK', warehouseCode: vars.warehouseCode, snapshotTs: vars.snapshotTimestamp, totalRows: sizeOf(vars.rawRows default []), correlationId: vars.correlationId }]

db:select.doc:name: Fetch Snapshot ID
db:select.db:sql: SELECT snapshot_id FROM snapshot_log WHERE file_name = :fileName LIMIT 1

db:update.doc:name: Mark Snapshot PROCESSED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE snapshot_log SET status = 'PROCESSED', accepted_rows = :acceptedCount, rejected_rows = :rejectedCount, skus_changed = :skusChanged, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE snapshot_id = :snapshotId

logger.doc:name: Log Snapshot Complete
logger.message: #['[Correlation ID: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ '] Snapshot successfully processed: ' ++ vars.sourceFileName]

ee:transform.doc:name: Format Valid Rows for Bulk SQL

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- (vars.validRows default []) map (row) -> { sku: row.sku, location: row.location, qty: row.countedQty, unitCost: row.unitCost, countedAt: row.countedAt, snapshotId: vars.snapshotId, correlationId: vars.correlationId }

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: DB: Bulk Upsert Inventory Stock
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO inventory_stock (sku, location_code, available_qty, unit_cost, last_counted_at, snapshot_id, updated_at) VALUES (:sku, :location, :qty, :unitCost, :countedAt, :snapshotId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE available_qty = VALUES(available_qty), unit_cost = VALUES(unit_cost), last_counted_at = VALUES(last_counted_at), snapshot_id = VALUES(snapshot_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: DB: Bulk Insert Stock Movements Audit
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO stock_movements (sku, location_code, previous_qty, new_qty, delta_qty, snapshot_id, correlation_id, recorded_at) VALUES (:sku, :location, 0, :qty, :qty, :snapshotId, :correlationId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

on-error-continue.doc:name: On Error Continue -> Map to MULE:DB_WRITE_FAIL

logger.doc:name: Log Database Write Failure
logger.message: #['[Correlation ID: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ '] Database batch transaction failed: ' ++ error.description]
